description:
The per-executable transport projection (project_one_executable -> project_executable_input_source) reaches the WHOLE closure via two backward scans: collect_call_arg_input_sources (transport.rs:2888 — scans every executable to find E's callers + arg values) and collect_callable_capture_input_sources (transport.rs:2939 — scans every executable to find producers whose callable_flows resolve to E). This backward pull is why the per-exec job cannot fire before SemanticClosed: E must see every other executable to discover who feeds it.

Invert to a forward push: build, once when contexts are assembled, an incoming-input-sources index keyed by (callee, semantic_index) -> [(caller, ValueId)], by iterating each executable's OUTGOING callsite_args and callable_flows. project_executable_input_source reads its entry instead of scanning. Delete both backward-scan fns. Bundle the index with the context map (it is a property of the context set) so it is built in the same pass.

Byte-identical (the final plan sorts all drafts, so source-set equality suffices); perf-positive (build once vs O(N) scan per input projection). This is the pull->push the data model needs before the index can become a contributed fact (5.5.2) and the barrier can lift (5.5.4).
title: Stage 4a: invert backward input-source scans into a forward push index
